source.document_locator: Table 2.1.5 - hydraulic analysis, hazard maps and information database development status
source.relationship_to_ana: Independent external study describing ANA flood-analysis assets and results received for comparison.

bounded_claims: ANA had prepared hazard maps for 14 rivers under the Tratamiento de Cauces para el Control de Inundaciones study family.
Those hazard maps were described as based on hydraulic analysis using HEC-RAS and HEC-GeoRAS.
The JICA study states that it obtained study results including hazard maps for 11 rivers, explicitly including the Santa River.
next_safe_gates: Search ANA/SNIRH archival holdings for the Santa HEC-RAS, HEC-GeoRAS, DEM/TIN, cross-section and floodplain export package.
Search JICA report annexes or institutional archive references for the Santa comparison dataset that the study states it obtained.
Do not infer that receipt of hazard-map results implies receipt of editable HEC-RAS/GeoRAS project files.
Do not transform the normalized native axis until datum and UTM zone are explicitly verified.
